settings.title: Repairs and re-waxing
settings.body: Send any Addison Emma garment to the workroom and we will mend, re-wax or re-line it. We keep the patterns for every piece we have made since 1994, so a replacement pocket bag or facing is cut from the original.

settings.title: Private appointments
settings.body: A fitter, the full collection, and as long as you need. Available in all four boutiques or by video call for clients further afield.

settings.title: Made to measure
settings.body: Our outerwear and tailoring can be cut to your measurements in any cloth we hold, with two fittings included. Begin with an appointment.

settings.title: Delivery and returns
settings.body: Complimentary insured shipping with duties included, delivered within three working days in France and five elsewhere. Returns within thirty days, collected by us.

settings.title: The archive
settings.body: Single sizes from past seasons, kept in the house at Saint-Côme. Write to us with what you are looking for and we will tell you honestly whether we have it.

settings.heading: Everything after the purchase
settings.form_body: An hour with a fitter, in the boutique or by video. No obligation to buy.
